decisions.reason: The polymer concrete housing belongs to the core drainage portfolio and costs little to keep. It no longer appeared on the website after 2018, but that does not show its value has failed, so the option stays open.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's accessible, low-profile direction. Keeping it is cheap even though it has had little visibility on the website.
The sloped shower element supports the firm's strategy, but its weak presence after launch adds some risk. Its results do not yet clearly justify abandoning it.
The backflow basement drain had a dedicated page and a specific development announcement. It meets a lasting regulatory and safety need, so its prospects stay favorable.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral accessory with little visibility. It still completes the system offering at low holding cost, so it is not worth abandoning yet.
